DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の開設をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to open an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家に届いたこの郵便には私の通称があるので、本人確認に使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通称宛ての郵便が本人確認に使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This letter delivered to my home has my commonly used name. Can it be used for identity verification?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether mail addressed to your commonly used name can verify your identity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使える資料は担当が確認します。公的な本人確認書類のお名前と同じ表記ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will check acceptable documents. Is the spelling the same as your official identity document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。郵便の宛名は普段呼ばれている名前で、本人の書類には正式な名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通称と本人書類の正式名の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The mail uses the name people usually call me, while my identity document has my official name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your commonly used name and official name on your document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず正式な書類の種類と表記を確認しましょう。お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let us check the type and spelling on the official document. Have you brought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。通称の郵便だけで本人確認が終わるとは考えず、必要書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正式書類を示して必要な資料の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here it is. I will not assume mail under my usual name alone completes identity verification. Please tell me the required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the official document and ask what documents are needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類とご状況に応じて担当が案内します。お仕事の資料も通称ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain according to your documents and circumstances. Do your work documents also use the usual name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一部だけ通称です。全部同じ表記だと言わず、違う資料を分けて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務関係資料も表記が一部違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only some do. I will not say everything has the same spelling; I will show the differing documents separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that some work-related documents also have a different name spelling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が必要な点を整理して担当につなぎます。今日はどこまで進めたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will organize the points needing confirmation and refer you to the staff member. How far would you like to proceed today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず必要な資料を確認したいです。不足があれば持ち帰り、そろえてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足資料を確認してそろえてから申し込む方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I want to confirm the required documents. If anything is missing, I will take the information home, gather everything, and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will identify missing documents and apply after gathering them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類の条件と申し込み方法を確認し、使えるか未確認の資料で手続きを進めないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us confirm document conditions and the application method so that you do not proceed using documents whose acceptability is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この袋は百円ですか。大きく百円と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百円表示が一袋の価格か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Is this bag one hundred yen? One hundred yen is written in large print.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the one-hundred-yen display is the price of one bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字の横の単位をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the unit beside that number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりですね。一袋の価格だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百グラム当たりの表示と読み違えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is per one hundred grams. I thought it was the price of one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you misread the per-one-hundred-gram display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の内容量と販売価格を確認しましょう。こちらは三百グラムで、販売価格は別に表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the bag's contents weight and selling price. This has three hundred grams, with its selling price displayed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一袋三百円とあります。今日は二百円以内で買いたいので、この袋は選べません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一袋三百円と予算二百円を比較して選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says three hundred yen per bag. I want to spend no more than two hundred yen today, so I cannot choose this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare three hundred yen per bag with your two-hundred-yen budget and say you will not choose it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい袋もあります。同じ商品の内容量違いを確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is also a smaller bag. Would you like to check the same product in a different quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。百グラム当たりが安いかより、今回払う合計が予算内かを先に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単位価格より今回の合計支払額を優先すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I want to check whether the total I will pay fits my budget before considering whether the unit price per one hundred grams is cheaper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize this purchase's total cost over the unit price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらは百五十グラムで一袋百七十円です。必要な量は足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is one hundred fifty grams for one hundred seventy yen per bag. Is that enough for what you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日使う分には足ります。税込みの支払額も確認して、この小さい袋を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要量と税込支払額を確認して小さい袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is enough for today's use. I will also confirm the tax-inclusive payment amount and choose this small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the needed quantity and tax-inclusive amount and choose the small bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小さい袋は税込み百七十円です。今日使う量と二百円以内の予算に合うこちらの一袋として、会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The small bag is one hundred seventy yen including tax. Please take this one bag to checkout; it matches today's quantity and your budget of no more than two hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの道についてお聞きになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which path would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あちらに工事の紙があるので、今日は通れないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工事の紙を見て今日も通れないと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a construction notice over there, so I thought it was impassable today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that seeing the construction notice made you think it was closed today too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 工事のお知らせには、期間が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the construction notice show the period?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の月曜日からとあります。紙が出ているだけで、今も閉鎖中だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掲示の開始日を読み予告と閉鎖を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says from next Monday. I thought it was already closed simply because the paper was posted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the posted start date and explain that you confused advance notice with a current closure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予告と現在の通行状況を分けて確認しましょう。柵や別の案内は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the advance notice separately from the current passage status. Did you see barriers or other signs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近づいていないので、わかりません。紙の日付だけで通れるとも決めず、担当に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場の状態は未確認なので担当へ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not approached it, so I do not know. I do not want to assume it is open based only on the date either; I would like the staff member to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member to check because the on-site condition is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の状況を確認します。今日はどのくらい歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the current situation. How long do you intend to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二十分ほどです。もしその道が使えなければ、入口側の短い道で休憩したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使えない場合の短い道と休憩の希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About twenty minutes. If that path cannot be used, I would like to rest along a short path near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your preference for a short route and rest if the path is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在通れる範囲とベンチをご案内します。来週も同じ道を使う予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show you the currently open area and benches. Do you plan to use the same path next week too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日の案内が来週も有効とは思わず、来る日に掲示を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回来園時には案内を確認し直す方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not assume today's information is valid next week; I will check the notices again when I come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will recheck the information on your next park visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の経路を先に確認し、次回はその時点の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check today's route first; next time, please follow the information current then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えについてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a transfer question?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この図では線が途切れているので、改札を出て乗り直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の途切れを理由に改札外へ出るか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The line is broken on this diagram. Do I go out through the gates and board again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the diagram's broken line means going outside the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の描き方だけでは判断できません。お持ちの乗車券と目的地を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide based on the drawing alone. We will check your ticket and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。改札を出る前に、乗り換え先までの歩き方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車券を示して改札を出る前の経路確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. Before I leave the gates, please tell me how to walk to the transfer train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and ask to check the route before leaving the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用の乗車券で通る経路を確認します。途切れた線のところには何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the route to use with your ticket. What does it say beside the broken line?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 徒歩連絡とあります。道路を歩くのか、駅の中を歩くのかがわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩連絡が駅内か道路か不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Walking connection. I do not know whether that means along a road or inside the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unclear whether the walking connection is inside the station or on a road. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通る通路と改札の扱いを係員が確認します。乗り換えに使える時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check the passage and how the gates should be used. Do you have time for the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十五分あります。ただ、迷った分も必要なので、すぐ走って間に合わせるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換時間を伝え無理に走らず確認する意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Fifteen minutes. But I also need allowance for getting lost, so I do not intend to run to make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your transfer time and intent to check rather than run recklessly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を見て進み、わからなければ途中の係員にも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Proceed by following the signs, and ask staff along the way if unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。途中で聞ける窓口と、乗り換え先の乗り場名もメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 途中の窓口と乗場名を記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I would like to note a counter I can ask along the way and the name of the transfer platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to record a counter along the way and the platform name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二点をお示しします。図の線だけで改札を出ず、ご案内した経路で進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will show you those two points. Do not leave the gates based only on the diagram's line; follow the route we explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書はどなたの分が必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にいる全員です。私と友達二人の三人分を、一つに載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居三人全員を一つの証明に載せたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Everyone in the house. I would like me and my two friends, all three of us, listed on one certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want all three co-residents listed on one certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ住所の方が、同じ世帯とは限りません。提出先から指定された証明書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: People at the same address are not necessarily in the same household. Has the submission destination specified a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内です。世帯全員とありますが、家の住人全員だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 世帯全員を家の住人全員と理解していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are the instructions. It says all household members, but I thought that meant everyone living in the house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understood all household members as all residents of the house. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住民登録の世帯について確認が必要です。お友達の登録状況はご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the household in resident registration. Do you know your friends' registration status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知りません。友達の分も私が取れると決めず、自分の登録と申請範囲を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の登録は不明で自分の申請範囲の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I do not want to assume I can obtain theirs too; I want to check my registration and the scope I can apply for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friends' registration is unknown and ask your own application scope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の申請について担当が確認します。提出先に必要な対象を聞くこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check your own application. You can also ask the destination who needs to be covered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友達が同じ世帯かを勝手に答えず、必要な証明の範囲を提出先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先に必要な対象を確認する方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not answer on my own that my friends are in the same household; I will check the required certificate scope with the destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your plan to check the necessary subjects with the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請枚数や記載項目も案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do the instructions also show the number of copies or fields to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所の記載はありますが、ほかの項目はわかりません。不明な項目を付け足す前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明な記載項目を追加せず相談する意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It mentions the address, but I do not know the other fields. I will ask before adding unknown items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask rather than add uncertain fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象と必要項目を整理し、ご本人が申請できる範囲からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will organize who is covered and the required fields, then explain starting with what you personally can apply for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入でお困りのところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any parts of the medical questionnaire you need help completing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない言葉の欄があります。わからないので、なしに丸を付けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未知の単語の欄をなしとしてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a field with a word I do not know. Since I do not understand, may I circle none?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can mark none in a field with an unknown word. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: わからないことと、ないことは違います。まだ丸を付けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Not knowing and having none are different. Have you not circled anything yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。意味を知らないだけで、ないと答えるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 意味が不明なだけで病歴なしとは答えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I only do not know the meaning; I do not intend to answer that I have no history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that only the meaning is unclear and you are not claiming no medical history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの欄ですか。まず言葉の意味を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which field is it? First, we will explain the word.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この「既往歴」です。今の症状を書く欄との違いを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既往歴と現在症状の欄の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This medical history field. Please tell me how it differs from the current-symptoms field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between medical history and current symptoms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: これまでにかかった病気などを伺う欄です。詳しい時期がわからないこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It asks about illnesses you have had in the past. Are there things whose exact dates you do not know?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どものころ入院しましたが、病名と年は家族に確認しないとわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 幼少期の入院は覚えているが詳細未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was hospitalized as a child, but I need to ask my family to know the illness name and year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you remember childhood hospitalization but the details are unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できていないことをそのまま診療担当へ伝えてください。思い出せる範囲で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the clinical staff exactly what is unconfirmed. Whatever you can remember is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、入院したことと詳細が未確認であることを分けて伝えます。現在の症状は別の欄に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既知の入院歴と未確認事項を分け現在症状は別に書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will distinguish having been hospitalized from the unconfirmed details. I will write my current symptoms in a separate field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate known hospitalization history from unknown details and put current symptoms elsewhere. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように記入して、受付で未確認の点があるとお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please fill it in that way and tell reception there are unconfirmed points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡が来ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of message did you receive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行の名前で、口座を使い続けるために写真を送るよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行名のメッセージで写真を求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Under the bank's name, it says to send a photo to keep using my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a message using a bank name asks for a photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの方法で写真を送るよう指示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How does it instruct you to send the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メッセージのリンクです。表示名が銀行なので本物だと思いましたが、まだ開いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンクはまだ開いておらず表示名を信用しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Through a link in the message. I thought it was genuine because the display name is the bank, but I have not opened it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the link is unopened and you nearly trusted the display name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示名だけで相手を確かめることはできません。何の写真を求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot verify the sender from the display name alone. What photo are they requesting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認書類です。送っていません。メッセージのリンクから確認せず、手元の銀行の資料で連絡先を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人書類を未送信で手元資料から連絡先を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: An identity document. I have not sent it. I will not verify through the message link; I will look up the contact in bank documents I already have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the identity document is unsent and you will check the contact from existing documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それがよいですね。メッセージの内容は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That sounds good. Have you kept the message contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。消す前に相談に必要な情報を確認したいです。他人にリンクを転送して試してもらうこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容を残して相談し他人へリンクを転送しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Before deleting anything, I want to check what information is needed for advice. I will not forward the link to others to have them try it either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the contents for consultation and do not forward the link for others to test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談先をご案内します。銀行にも、ご自身で確認した連絡先から事情を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show you where to seek advice. Please also tell the bank through contact details you have verified yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。口座が本当に止まっているとは決めず、銀行側で現在の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座停止を断定せず銀行で実状態を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not conclude my account is actually blocked; I will check its current status with the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume account suspension; check the actual status with the bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。メッセージの要求と口座の実際の状態を分けて相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please discuss the message's demands separately from the actual state of your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物には何が入っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電子機器です。電池は外して、同じ箱の小袋に入れる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電子機器と外した電池を同梱する予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: An electronic device. I plan to remove the battery and put it in a small bag in the same box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to pack an electronic device together with its removed battery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機器から外していても、電池も荷物に含まれるのですね。種類がわかる表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the parcel still includes the battery even if it is removed from the device. Is there a label identifying its type?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。外してあれば電池なしとして送れると思っていましたが、表示を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電池なしと考えた誤解を訂正して表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought removing it meant I could send it as containing no battery, but I will show the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the assumption of no battery and show the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機器と電池の種類や状態によって確認が必要です。電池に破損などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check according to the device and battery type and condition. Is the battery damaged in any way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た範囲ではありませんが、自分では異常の有無を保証できません。以前の電池の箱も持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見た状態と異常の未保証を分け元の箱を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not as far as I can see, but I cannot guarantee there is no abnormality myself. I also have its original box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate what you observed from not guaranteeing its condition and show the original box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。すでに梱包されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the staff member. Is it already packed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ封を閉じていません。小袋に入れれば十分とは決めず、梱包方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未封で梱包方法の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not sealed it yet. I will not assume a small bag is sufficient; I would like to ask how to pack it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is unsealed and ask to check the packing method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。送付先は国内ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 国内です。送れるかと条件がわかるまで受付を進めず、必要なら電池を別に扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 国内宛てで条件確認まで発送を進めない方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not proceed with acceptance until I know whether it can be sent and under what conditions. If necessary, I will handle the battery separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the domestic destination and that you will not ship before checking conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容と表示を担当に確認してもらいましょう。送付可否と梱包条件が確認できてから準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us have the staff member check the contents and label. Please prepare only after shipping eligibility and packing conditions are confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込に必要な情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the information needed for the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、二枚あります。新しい紙の金額で、古い紙の口座に振り込もうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の案内から金額と口座を組み合わせる予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, two sheets. I am thinking of sending the amount on the new sheet to the account on the old sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to combine amount and account information from two instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚は同じ依頼元ですか。口座の記載も比べて確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both from the same sender? Have you compared the account details too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ会社名ですが、口座番号が違いました。金額だけ新しくすればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ会社名でも口座番号が異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have the same company name, but different account numbers. I thought only the amount needed updating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the company names match but the account numbers differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在有効な依頼内容を、依頼元へ確認してから進めたほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be better to confirm the currently valid request with the company before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、二枚を混ぜて入力せず、どちらの案内が有効か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別版を混ぜず有効な案内を依頼元へ確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not mix the two sheets in the entry; I will check which instructions are valid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not mix versions; ask the requesting company which instructions are valid. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先はどの資料で確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which document will you use to check the contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前から使っている契約書の連絡先です。新しい紙の連絡先だけでは確認したことにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の契約書で確認した連絡先を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contact in the contract I have used from before. I will not consider it verified using only the new sheet's contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the contact verified in the previous contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後、金額や期限も合わせて確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, please also confirm the amount and deadline together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。口座だけでなく、金額と支払期限も同じ案内でそろえて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座と金額と期限を同じ案内で確認する方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check not only the account but also the amount and payment deadline together in the same instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check account, amount, and deadline using the same instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた案内で必要情報を整理してください。未確認のまま送金せず、操作の前にもう一度見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please organize the necessary information using confirmed instructions. Do not transfer money while anything is unconfirmed; review it once more before operating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品から読み取りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will scan this product first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その一つは今日買う物ではありません。昨日買って、返品を相談するために持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参品は今日買う物ではなく返品相談のためだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: That one is not something I am buying today. I bought it yesterday and brought it to ask about returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the item you brought is for a return inquiry, not today's purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ返品は受け付けていない商品ですね。ほかの買い物と分けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the return has not yet been accepted. Could you separate it from your other shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらに分けます。かごに一緒に入れたので、わかりにくくしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未受付の商品を買い物かごから分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I will put it here separately. I made it confusing by putting it together in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the unaccepted return item from the shopping basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返品の担当へご案内します。昨日のレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show you to the returns staff. Do you have yesterday's receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。この商品を買った行を示しますが、返品できるかは先に担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日のレシートを示して返品可否の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will point to the line for this purchase, but I want the staff member to check first whether it can be returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's receipt and ask to check return eligibility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日のお買い物はこのまま会計されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you pay for today's shopping as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今日買う二つは別に支払います。返品予定の金額を引いて払うつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の購入品を別会計し未確定返品額を差し引かないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will pay separately for the two items I am buying today. I do not intend to deduct an expected return amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay separately for today's goods without subtracting an unconfirmed refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返品の結果を確認してから、その手続きは別に行います。袋も分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will process the return separately after confirming the result. Would you like separate bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。持参した商品と購入した商品がまた混ざらないよう、分けて持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参品と購入品を分けて袋に入れるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will carry them separately so the brought item and purchased items do not get mixed again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for separate bags for the brought item and purchases. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の会計を確認した後、持参商品と昨日のレシートを返品担当へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. After checking today's payment, please give the brought item and yesterday's receipt to the returns staff.
